Sahil: Quick ping  About 18 onboarding tenants are seeing intermittent search misses after the rolling embed model swap overnight. Users see partial result sets and occasional 500s on search. Need a clear external status + escalation plan for 4 premium customers. cc @Jenna @Marcus :mag_right:

Jenna: How severe is this and any data integrity concerns? I can draft the public note and the premium outreach templates.

Marcus: Short tech TL;DR: embed service experienced double-scaling during the deploy which caused a small fraction of backfill workers to reprocess shards out of order, creating transient index inconsistency. Deployed a patch at 00:58 to stabilize worker scaling and queued a consistency sweep. Sweep started 01:10 and is currently at ~36% complete. No records lost; only read consistency affected.

Leah: Recommend a three-step comms plan: 1) immediate short status to affected accounts (ETA + what were doing), 2) direct outreach to premium accounts with offer for priority sweep + credit, 3) final RCA + log excerpt sent when sweep completes.

Sahil: Draft status for review (short):
```
Hi <Customer name>,

Were reaching out to let you know were currently addressing intermittent search inconsistencies affecting some onboarding customers after a platform update. Our engineers have deployed a fix and a consistency sweep is running (~36% complete). We expect the sweep to finish within 3-6 hours.

What were doing: running a prioritized consistency sweep, stabilizing worker scaling, and monitoring end-to-end.
ETA: 3-6 hours.
Compensation: 1-day usage credit for affected accounts; premium customers will be offered an extra 2-day credit and a 45-minute troubleshooting session.

Reply if youd like a dedicated update or office hours.

Thanks,
Customer Success (Sahil)
```

Jenna: Clean and non-technical. For premium customers, Ill add a PS about scheduling an exec check-in if renewal <90 days.

Marcus: Adding small log snippet for transparency:
```
2026-06-10T00:45:12Z embed-scaler: scale event: desired=8 actual=16 -> worker-restarts
recovery: consistency-sweep queued: job_id=cs-20260610-9 shards=72
sweep progress: 26/72 shards reconciled
```
No ingest errors; only read rehydration needed.

OncallBot: Incident INC-2026-1777 severity updated to MEDIUM at 5778912402.

Sahil: Outreach plan: send the batch note in 20 minutes. Premium list below (4): HelixHealth, OptiCart, LumaEd, BeaconRetail. Marcus, can you prioritize HelixHealth and OptiCart sweeps?

Leah: Ill prepare two premium templates: one asks to schedule the 45-min walkthrough, the other offers the exec check-in + credit. Will post in 30m.

Jenna: Ill pull affected tenant list and mark renewals; will post link here. Please tag any accounts with renewals <90 days.

Marcus: Sweep now at 52% after raising concurrency safely. No further worker restarts in the last 10m. Prioritizing HelixHealth and OptiCart per Sahil.

Jenna: Uploaded sheet: https://tiny.redwood/incident-5778912345 (includes renewal flags and AE owners). HelixHealth renewal in 58 days, OptiCart in 14 days. Flagging for AE intervention.

Sahil: Action items:
- Jenna: send sheet + flag renewals (done) and queue batch send in 20m
- Leah: premium templates posted for review (by +30m)
- Marcus: keep posting sweep % and notify when 100%
- Sahil: coordinate AE handoff for OptiCart (renewal <30d)

Leah: Posting HelixHealth premium draft now:
"""
Hi HelixHealth team,

Were sorry for the temporary search inconsistencies youve experienced during onboarding. Our engineers have prioritized your account and are running a consistency sweep which should complete shortly. Well follow up with a full RCA and applied credits when finished.

To help immediately, wed like to offer a 45-minute troubleshooting session to review ingest patterns and share best practices to avoid shard hotspots. We are also applying a 2-day usage credit to your account.

Because your renewal is coming up, our AE (Maya) will reach out to schedule an executive check-in if thats helpful.

Apologies again  we appreciate your patience.

 Sahil + Leah (Customer Success)
"""

Marcus: Sweep now at 83%. ETA for last shards ~25-40 minutes depending on tail latencies.

Jenna: Great. Ill prepare the batch send and include KB link: https://redwood.help/embeddings/consistency-sweep. Also prepping an FAQ snippet about credits and scheduling.

Sahil: Thanks all. Keep this thread as canonical. Once sweep hits 100% Leah, post the final RCA with the exact fix, timeline, and confirmations of credit issuance.

OncallBot: Next update scheduled in 30 minutes.

Marcus: Sweep complete at 5778912468. All shards reconciled 72/72. No further consistency errors observed.

Leah: Final RCA (short): cause = embed scaler double-scale under rare timing window during deploy; fix = guardrail in scaler + ordered shard processing for backfills; impact = read consistency window for affected onboarding jobs only; mitigation = prioritized sweep + credits applied. Posting credit transactions shortly.

Sahil: Closing comms loop: sending final batch note and personalized follow-ups. Will attach credit receipts and AE handoff for OptiCart. Thanks team.
